name: YTL Corporation Berhad
overview: 2026年度，YTL Corporation Berhad 的公告主要涉及股份分拆/附加上市、季度业绩、财务援助和股息除权，未披露各业务板块的具体扩张、缩减、出售或新合约信息。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增长34.1%，净利润同比增长6.4%。
overview_en: In 2026, YTL Corporation Berhad's announcements mainly covered share subdivision/additional listings, quarterly results, financial assistance, and dividend ex-date, without disclosing specific expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contract details for business segments. For the latest quarter ended 30 Sep 2026, revenue grew 34.1% year-on-year and net profit grew 6.4% year-on-year.
